trans-unit.source: Escape Style : Defines how special characters (commas, colons, backslashes, etc.) should be escaped when serializing text values into TOON format.
Minimum Rows to Tabular : Determines the minimum number of sequential rows required for an array to be rendered as a tabular block in TOON.
Maximum Preview Items : Controls how many items are displayed when rendering long tabular arrays or datasets in TOON format.

Coerce Scalar Types : When decoding TOON back to JSON/PHP arrays, this setting decides whether textual scalars such as "true", "false", "null", or "42" should be converted to their native PHP types (boolean, null, int).
